name: phd-nd-non-degree-before-admission
description: Policy review 2026-10-03 (Academic Code §2.3): “No more than 12 credit hours earned by a student while in non-degree status may be counted toward a degree program.” A Notre Dame graduate course dated before the entry term, with no earlier graduate program on the record, used to be refused outright; the standing card now asks — only when such a course is detected — whether the student was a non-degree (unclassified) student then. Answered yes, the course counts provisionally inside the twelve and goes to the DGS.
